payload.author: claude
payload.body: In progress (Wave 1): fixing the SERVER half — the Rust gateway (crates/frick-server/src/gateway.rs) registered the subscription AFTER async per-record authz, so a write immediately after a returned Subscribe could see subscribers:0. Moving registration ahead of the authz window (delivery still gated on authz). The Swift/Kotlin/web client halves (resolve on server registration, not frame send) remain a follow-up. Note: the TS server half referenced in the ticket is moot (deleted) — the Rust gateway is the live server now.
